description: Source code implementing event handling functions for Zigbee HAL (zhal) events, including parsing JSON events, invoking callbacks, and managing device events and firmware updates.

methods.name: handleClusterCommandReceived
methods.description: Parses a JSON event for a cluster command, constructs a ReceivedClusterCommand object, decodes base64 command data, and invokes the clusterCommandReceived callback.

methods.name: handleAttributeReportReceived
methods.description: Parses a JSON event for an attribute report, constructs a ReceivedAttributeReport object, decodes base64 report data, and invokes the attributeReportReceived callback.

methods.name: handleFirmwareVersionNotifyEventReceived
methods.description: Handles firmware version notification events, extracting EUI64 and version, then invoking the corresponding callback.

methods.name: handleFirmwareUpgradingEventReceived
methods.description: Handles firmware upgrading events, extracting EUI64 and notifying via callback.

methods.name: handleFirmwareUpgradeCompletedEventReceived
methods.description: Handles firmware upgrade completion events, extracting EUI64 and notifying via callback.

methods.name: handleFirmwareUpgradeFailedEventReceived
methods.description: Handles firmware upgrade failure events, extracting EUI64 and notifying via callback.

methods.name: handleDeviceCommunicationSucceededEventReceived
methods.description: Handles device communication success events, extracting EUI64 and notifying via callback.

methods.name: handleDeviceCommunicationFailedEventRecieved
methods.description: Handles device communication failure events, extracting EUI64 and notifying via callback.

methods.name: handleDeviceAnnounced
methods.description: Processes device announcement events, parsing device type and power source, then invoking the deviceAnnounced callback.

methods.name: handleDeviceRejoinedEventReceived
methods.description: Handles device rejoined events, extracting EUI64 and security status, then invoking callback.

methods.name: handleLinkKeyUpdatedEventReceived
methods.description: Processes link key update events, extracting EUI64 and key type, then invoking callback.

methods.name: handlePanIdAttackEventReceived
methods.description: Invokes pan ID attack detected callback.

methods.name: handlePanIdAttackClearedEventReceived
methods.description: Invokes pan ID attack cleared callback.

methods.name: zhalHandleEvent
methods.description: Main event handler that dispatches JSON events to specific handlers based on eventType, manages callback invocation, and cleans up JSON object.
